title: I Deleted 1 Memory Every Day for $100,000
description:
Pip discovered a secret app called MindPurge that paid $100,000 cash for every deleted memory. At first, it seemed like free money. Erasing bad grades, awkward dates, and boring jobs bought him penthouses, luxury supercars, and millions in cash.

But when the app demanded his Core Memories—and his head began glitching into digital static—Pip uncovered the terrifying underground truth about who was buying his memories...

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 - Day 1: The First $100,000
0:38 - Day 30: The $3 Million Spending Spree
1:15 - Day 60: The Identity Glitch
1:52 - The Underground Memory Vault
2:25 - OPTION A vs OPTION B (The Impossible Choice)

💬 THE ULTIMATE DILEMMA:
Option A: Restore all your stolen memories & identity, but return to $0 broke.
Option B: Keep $10,000,000 in cash, but remain a stranger to yourself forever.

Which do you choose? Tell us in the comments below!
